note: Still a concept, not a ruling: the second pass on I-001, given in chat on 2026-10-11 after its sketch ("i like the design, some tweaks"). It supersedes nothing and I-001 stays as written. D-380, D-458, D-459, D-442, D-189 and luxury D-355 / D-359 stand, and panel_ribbon, devices DV24 / DV53, parts P083 / P155-P157, the panel board (H-008) and the DCU carrier stay as they are until he rules. The sketch (00-design/panel-concept.html, not in the repository) is redrawn to these words. What it would touch if he ruled it: (1) a second plate left of the steering wheel carrying the two wink switches over the fuel-door and hatch release keys, with the mirror stick beside them - today the winks are DV24 "dash panel" on route RT10 and the two releases and the stick are on the centre panel's board (panel_ribbon 3 ROW1, and 1 / 17-20). The winks stay hardwired to the PMU either way (L3-S1 9-11, D-189, luxury D-210); the releases and the stick would leave the centre board and need their own cable from the DCU to the new plate, which D-380 / D-459 (one board, one ribbon) do not have. (2) A lit symbol on each of the five: P083 (round momentary pushbuttons, in the cart, not bought) carries no symbol, so the wink switch part or its cap would change - money, a block when he rules; and five more lights than D-458's count, on a plate the panel's LED driver does not reach today. (3) The mirror select: left by default, push then move for the right - D-359 and D-442 have a push that toggles left / right and stays. How long the right stays selected is not in his words. (4) The windows: one centre-sprung up / down switch per window in place of two keys each - the same two contacts to the matrix, a different part and faceplate cut. (5) The four centre keys carry symbols, not words, and the symbol is the light (luxury LP20, luxury block 03.14). (6) The screen shows no A/C mark and no recirculate mark and loses its "FAN" and "SET TEMP" labels; the A/C stays automatic and unseen (D-211 and engine block 02.15 still govern whether there is a compressor to switch). Read as: "moves the right knob" is the right mirror; "that cluster of 4" is the two winks and the two releases; "the two temp numbers" are the set temperature and the outside air, as I-001 has it ("if chosen temp is bellow outside temp"), so the outside air stays on the screen; "back light" is backlit.
